_doc: Building models of the Littleroot/Route 101/Oldale slice in exterior pack 0 (patches/area2_buildings.py). models: res id (an existing pack-0 id is replaced, a new one appended), model file, door res and door offset (the game draws the door model at the building origin + (dx, dz); 65535 = no door), optional type (info record type, default 0; 11 = event prop that scripts hide with BMSetVisible 8, x, z, 0). textures: [building texture set file in work/tex, texture name] pairs merged losslessly into pack 0's texture set. Door dx = door tile centre - footprint centre + 8 for doors 164/165/236/259-261 (their models span x -18..2 around the door origin) and + 0 for door_pc 93 (centred); measured in the built world by b2tools/exterior_check.py buildings (2026-10-06: Littleroot's houses/lab and Oldale's houses were 8 units left). Door dz: the door model's glass (door 165/236 at z 0, 164 at -1) and plate (+2) must stay 1 unit or more off the wall and frame planes they overlap (melonDS flicker); dz was moved forward where b2tools/exterior_check.py found them closer (exterior sweep 2026-10-06). door_pc (93): dz = the front wall's z - 4, so its curved arc's ends stand on the wall under the canopy the models build over it (buildings.pc_door_hood); walls over the other doors are buildings.DOOR_WALL (38) high: b2tools/door_check.py (door_fix 2026-10-11).
_drop_doc: Black 2 models no Hoenn registry, town, sign or door uses (Route 1 seasonal trees, outwarp, gate_01, Unova props): 69,880 B. Keep rock_01 (21): the default model.
